purpose: Owner-scoped Manus API and shared-journal MCP connection pilot
runtime_requirements: Python >=3.10; standard library sqlite3 + urllib + hmac
Fresh Windows install evidence must be checked in external receipt; Linux/macOS UNVERIFIED

input_contract.cli: Documented JSON-output commands; host private state and signed controller grant outside kit
input_contract.mcp: JSON-lines stdio initialize/initialized/tools/list/tools/call; authority not client supplied
input_contract.mutations: Owner authorization + task_id/worker_id/attempt/idempotency_key + fresh scoped grant

output_contract.cli: Structured JSON, exit0 command completion or exit1 FAIL_OR_BLOCKED
output_contract.evidence: Durable private SQLite journal and callback outbox
output_contract.release: Manifest hashes, outer checksum and scoped QA receipts

authentication_requirements: Own MANUS_API_KEY from process environment or Windows User env; never included
Host controller signs/records grants in private state; grant/authority key excluded
known_limits: Private pilot; customer license/support terms unresolved
No native Work activation binding manufactured by this kit
Grant trust assumes protected host filesystem, not same-user sandbox isolation
Read-only reconcile may use expired valid grant; mutations cannot
One brief lite task authorized in pilot; no purchase/top-up/publish
Publisher signature/provenance verification separate from internal manifest consistency
